catalog.name: Guardian
catalog.description: A nimble warrior specializing in lightsaber combat, using finesse and defensive techniques to overwhelm opponents.
catalog.quote: Through the Force, I am the shield that guards the innocent.
catalog.legacyNotes: Attack +7, Reflex Defense 19, HP 32. Block talent allows negating melee attacks with Use the Force check.

catalog.name: Consular
catalog.description: A Force-focused diplomat who relies on manipulation of the Force and wisdom rather than lightsaber combat.
catalog.quote: The Force flows through all things. Let it guide your path to peace.
catalog.legacyNotes: Use the Force +9, Will Defense 18, 4 Force Powers. Force Sight ability ignores concealment. Force Focus allows regaining spent Force Power.

catalog.name: Defender
catalog.description: A durable frontline protector who can deflect attacks and shield allies from harm.
catalog.quote: I can't afford to lose this fight! There are people depending on me.
catalog.legacyNotes: HP 35, Fort Defense 19, Use the Force +9 for Deflect checks. Zabrak CON bonus makes this an excellent tank. Scarred background grants Favorable Circumstances when Intimidating.

catalog.name: Sentinel
catalog.description: An investigative shadow who hunts down dark side corruption with precision and stealth.
catalog.quote: Darkness cannot hide from those who seek the light.
catalog.legacyNotes: Use the Force +9, Will Defense 18. Force Sight ignores concealment. Dark Side Sense allows rerolls to detect dark siders. Nar Shaddaa Origin adds Stealth as class skill for +3 bonus.

catalog.name: Diplomat
catalog.description: The ultimate social character, capable of talking their way through any situation with charm and persuasion.
catalog.quote: Words can open doors that even the strongest blade cannot.
catalog.legacyNotes: Persuasion +18 with Zeltron bonuses, Will Defense 16. Inspire Confidence grants +1 morale bonus to all allies.

catalog.name: Leader
catalog.description: A tactical commander who coordinates allies and inspires greatness on the battlefield.
catalog.quote: Victory belongs to those who fight together as one!
catalog.legacyNotes: HP 20, Reflex 13, Will 17. Born Leader grants swift action +1 insight bonus to allies' attacks.

catalog.name: Aristocrat
catalog.description: A wealthy manipulator with extensive resources, connections, and information networks.
catalog.quote: Information is the galaxy's most valuable currency, and I am very wealthy.
catalog.legacyNotes: 10 trained skills, 6,500 starting credits with Wealth talent. Bothan bonuses to Gather Information. Fondor Origin adds Mechanics as class skill for +3 bonus.

system.benefit: Each time you gain a level (including the level at which you select this Talent), you receive 5,000 credits for each level you have in a Lineage-eligible class (Noble and Corporate Agent). Each eligible level is granted only once.

description.value:
Each time you gain a level (including the level at which you select this Talent), you receive 5,000 credits for each level you have in a Lineage-eligible class (Noble and Corporate Agent). Each eligible level is granted only once.

The credits appear in a civilized, accessible location of your choice or in your private bank account.

catalog.name: Duelist
catalog.description: A social character with surprising melee combat effectiveness using grace and finesse.
catalog.quote: Elegance in both word and blade—a true noble's art.
catalog.legacyNotes: Melee attack +5 using CHA, 2d6 damage, HP 19. Noble Fencing Style allows using CHA for light melee attacks. Scarred background grants Favorable Circumstances when Intimidating.

catalog.name: Guard
catalog.description: A trained soldier responsible for protecting installations, personnel, or assets. Guards provide steady, reliable defensive support and tactical awareness.
catalog.quote: My duty is to protect those who cannot protect themselves.
catalog.legacyNotes: Nonheroic template: No talents or Force powers. Feats must come from restricted nonheroic list. Skill training = 1 + Int mod (minimum 1).

catalog.name: Scout/Pathfinder
catalog.description: An experienced scout or guide who excels at wilderness survival, tracking, and reconnaissance. Scouts rely on cunning and perception rather than military discipline.
catalog.quote: The wilds are my home; I am never lost.
catalog.legacyNotes: Nonheroic template: No talents or Force powers. Focuses on outdoor survival skills.

catalog.name: Laborer/Worker
catalog.description: A common laborer, factory worker, or tradesperson. Workers are skilled in practical tasks and basic survival, forming the foundation of civilian society.
catalog.quote: Honest work is its own reward.
catalog.legacyNotes: Nonheroic template: No talents or Force powers. Basic combat training only.

catalog.name: Wolf
catalog.description: A wild wolf or wolf-like creature. Beasts are non-sapient or low-intelligence creatures generated through the Creature Generator system. Wolves are pack hunters with keen senses and natural combat instincts.
catalog.quote: The strength of the pack is the wolf, and the strength of the wolf is the pack.
catalog.legacyNotes: Beast template: Intelligence 1-2 constraint enforced. No talents. No starting feats. Skills constrained to Beast list (Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Perception, Stealth, Survival, Swim). 1d8+Con HP. No Force/Destiny Points. Multiclass gate at Int 3+.

senses: Keen scent (DC 15 Perception to avoid being perceived)
specialQualities: Pack Tactics (advantage on melee attack rolls if ally is within 5 squares)

catalog.name: Bear
catalog.description: A wild bear or bear-like creature. Beasts are non-sapient or low-intelligence creatures generated through the Creature Generator system. Bears are apex predators with immense strength and natural combat prowess.
catalog.quote: The forest yields to those with claw and fang.
catalog.legacyNotes: Beast template: Intelligence 1-2 constraint enforced. No talents. No starting feats. Skills constrained to Beast list (Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Perception, Stealth, Survival, Swim). 1d8+Con HP. No Force/Destiny Points. Multiclass gate at Int 3+.

senses: Keen scent (DC 15 Perception to avoid being perceived)
specialQualities: Powerful Build (counts as one size larger for carrying capacity)
Maul (if Bear hits with both claw attacks, can make bonus bite attack)

catalog.name: Worker
catalog.description: A skilled laborer, mechanic, or technician. Workers are the backbone of galactic civilization, maintaining infrastructure and repairing equipment.
catalog.quote: Honest work, honest pay. That's all I need.
catalog.legacyNotes: Mechanics +10, HP ~7 (1d4+1). 3 starting feats: Skill Training (Mechanics), Skill Training (Use Computer), Skill Focus (Mechanics). Workers make excellent technicians and support personnel. Extra 820 credits in equipment for field work.

catalog.name: Trooper
catalog.description: A baseline soldier, guard, or militia member. Troopers have basic military training but lack the experience and skill of true heroes.
catalog.quote: Following orders. That's what keeps the galaxy running.
catalog.legacyNotes: Attack +1, Reflex 11, HP ~7 (1d4+1). 3 starting feats: Armor Proficiency (Light), Weapon Proficiency (Rifles), Weapon Proficiency (Pistols). Standard military trooper. Extra 755 credits in military equipment.

catalog.name: Criminal
catalog.description: A petty thug, gang member, or street criminal. Criminals live on the edge of society, relying on intimidation and violence.
catalog.quote: Credits or your life. Your choice.
catalog.legacyNotes: Attack +1, Deception +7, HP ~6 (1d4+0). 3 starting feats: Weapon Proficiency (Pistols), Weapon Proficiency (Simple Weapons), Skill Training (Deception). Street criminals and thugs. Extra 750 credits in illicit equipment.

catalog.name: Merchant
catalog.description: A trader, shopkeeper, or business professional. Merchants know the value of everything and have connections throughout the commercial sector.
catalog.quote: Everything has a price, my friend. Let's negotiate.
catalog.legacyNotes: Persuasion +10, Gather Information +7, HP ~6 (1d4+0). 3 starting feats: Skill Training (Persuasion), Skill Training (Gather Information), Skill Focus (Persuasion). Merchants excel at social interactions. Extra 765 credits in business equipment.

catalog.name: Police Officer
catalog.description: A law enforcement officer, security guard, or constable. Police maintain order and enforce laws in civilized systems.
catalog.quote: By the authority of the law, stand down!
catalog.legacyNotes: Perception +8, Reflex 11, HP ~7 (1d4+1). 3 starting feats: Armor Proficiency (Light), Weapon Proficiency (Pistols), Skill Training (Perception). Local law enforcement. Extra 775 credits in law enforcement equipment.

catalog.name: Pistoleer
catalog.description: A precision shooter who deals devastating damage with sneak attacks from the shadows.
catalog.quote: They never see it coming. That's the whole point.
catalog.legacyNotes: Attack +4, 3d8+3 damage (4d8+3 vs flat-footed), Reflex Defense 17. Precise Shot removes shooting into melee penalty.

catalog.name: Skill Monkey
catalog.description: A versatile specialist covering social, technical, and infiltration roles with expertise.
catalog.quote: Every problem has a solution. You just need the right skills.
catalog.legacyNotes: Use Computer +10, 8 trained skills. Knack allows rerolling one skill check per day.

catalog.name: Knuckledragger
catalog.description: An aggressive street fighter who pushes enemies down the condition track with dirty tactics.
catalog.quote: No such thing as a fair fight when survival's on the line.
catalog.legacyNotes: Attack +5 with DEX 18. Dastardly Strike moves targets -1 condition track when denied DEX bonus. Enslaved background grants +2 competence to Grapple checks.

catalog.name: Outlaw
catalog.description: A charming rogue who uses luck and Force Points strategically to turn the odds in their favor.
catalog.quote: Luck? I make my own luck, friend.
catalog.legacyNotes: Persuasion +9 (+14 with Fool's Luck). Fool's Luck spends Force Point for +1 attack OR +5 skills OR +1 defenses.

catalog.name: Brigand
catalog.description: A roguish brigand who combines exceptional piloting skills with tactical combat prowess, striking from unexpected angles with deadly precision.
catalog.quote: The galaxy's wealth flows to those bold enough to take it.
catalog.legacyNotes: Attack +6 with exceptional Dexterity (18), Reflex Defense 18. Flawless Pilot allows rerolling Pilot checks and taking the better result. Opportunistic Strike enables bonus attacks against enemies that provoke for allies. Starting equipment emphasizes point-blank precision strikes with the Needler as backup poison option.

catalog.name: Sniper
catalog.description: A long-range precision shooter who operates from concealment with deadly accuracy.
catalog.quote: One shot, one kill. That's all it takes.
catalog.legacyNotes: Professional pilot with exceptional reflexes and marksmanship. Flawless Pilot allows rerolling Pilot checks and taking the better result. Surveillance talent provides enhanced reconnaissance capabilities. Duro Origin adds Use Computer as class skill for +3 bonus.

catalog.name: Engineer
catalog.description: A skilled technician who specializes in maintenance, repair, and engineering solutions in the field.
catalog.quote: Every problem has a technical solution.
catalog.legacyNotes: Master technician with exceptional perception and intelligence. Mon Calamari Shipwright provides expertise in starship systems. Skill Focus (Perception) reflects Mon Calamari natural observational abilities. Fondor Origin adds Use Computer as class skill for +3 bonus.

catalog.name: Pistoleer
catalog.description: A skilled rider specializing in hit-and-run tactics from a speeder bike, utilizing dual-weapon mastery.
catalog.quote: Speed and precision - that's all you need.
catalog.legacyNotes: Elite rider with exceptional dexterity and extra arms. Codru-Ji Dual Weapon Mastery I allows dual-wielding with extra arms advantage. Mechanized Rider talent allows advanced speeder bike maneuvers. Tatooine Origin adds Ride as class skill for +3 bonus.

catalog.name: Survivalist
catalog.description: A wilderness expert who excels at tracking and surviving the harshest conditions.
catalog.quote: The wilderness doesn't forgive mistakes. Neither do I.
catalog.legacyNotes: Survival +12, HP 42, Fort Defense 15. Evasion grants half damage on area attacks (no damage on miss).

catalog.name: Infiltrator
catalog.description: A stealthy infiltrator specializing in reconnaissance and espionage operations.
catalog.quote: The best battles are the ones your enemy never knew you fought.
catalog.legacyNotes: Stealth +18 at level 1. Improved Stealth reduces movement penalty from -10 to -5. Bothawui Origin adds Deception as class skill for +3 bonus.

catalog.name: Rifleman
catalog.description: A straightforward soldier carrying a slugthrower rifle and a big pistol. Perfect for new players learning weapon versatility and the practical Bandolier.
catalog.quote: I've got firepower. Let's see what you've got.
catalog.legacyNotes: Houk physiology provides natural durability. Commanding Presence: Once per encounter (Swift Action), all opponents within 6 squares take -2 penalty to Will Defense (Mind-Affecting Fear effect). Persuasion is a Class Skill for this character. Introduces the Bandolier (retrieve ammo/grenades with move action). When able, swap Slugthrower Rifle for a Heavy Weapon. Starting equipment includes Force Unleashed and Commanding Presence talents.

catalog.name: Gunner
catalog.description: A heavy weapons specialist focusing on area suppression and overwhelming firepower.
catalog.quote: More firepower solves most problems.
catalog.legacyNotes: 3d10 damage with autofire capability. Excels at suppressing multiple enemies.

catalog.name: Brawler
catalog.description: A fearsome Mantellian Savrip brawler wielding natural claws and innate ferocity. Solid walls of muscle and primal power, devastating in close combat.
catalog.quote: Feel the wrath of the claws!
catalog.legacyNotes: Natural Weapons (claws) deal 1d6 slashing damage and poison targets on hit. Large size provides +5 damage threshold but -1 reflex penalty. Rage ability grants +2 melee bonus once per day. STR 22 (after +4 racial), CON 20 (after +4 racial). Natural Armor +2 to Reflex Defense. Speed 8 squares. Cannot take Heavy Weapons, Pistol, or Rifle proficiencies.

catalog.name: Tank
catalog.description: An armored defender designed to absorb massive amounts of damage and protect allies.
catalog.quote: Behind me, soldier. I'll handle this.
catalog.legacyNotes: HP 40, Reflex 21, Fort 19. Gen'Dai damage threshold is doubled! Crippled background means Damage Threshold ignores Condition Track penalties - perfect synergy for an unkillable tank.

catalog.name: Commando
catalog.description: A specialized commando operative trained for elite strike missions and team-based combat operations.
catalog.quote: With my squad at my side, we can handle anything.
catalog.legacyNotes: Elite commando with Sullustan darkvision and heightened awareness. Comrades in Arms grants +1 bonus to all melee and ranged attacks when within 3 squares of an ally. Sullust Origin adds Stealth as class skill for +3 bonus, perfect for elite strike missions.

catalog.name: Reconnaissance Probe
catalog.description: Fast-moving sensor scout and tactical spotter
catalog.legacyNotes: Fourth-degree with small size; dexterity rises from 15 to 19. Carries a concealable defensive weapon.

catalog.legacyNotes: Second-degree nonviolence inhibitor applies; weapon is for proportionate defense.

catalog.description: Mobile ranged defender with integrated protection
catalog.legacyNotes: Soldier grants light-armor proficiency; rifle is wielded with both granted hands.

catalog.description: Heavy-duty melee guardian and boarding unit
catalog.legacyNotes: Fourth-degree avoids the fifth-degree nonviolence inhibitor while keeping Strength 15 higher than Dexterity 12.

catalog.description: Diagnostic analyst, field medic and knowledge specialist
catalog.legacyNotes: First-degree nonviolence inhibitor and obedience limits apply; hold-out blaster is emergency defense.

catalog.description: Diplomat, public liaison and cultural interpreter
catalog.legacyNotes: Third-degree droid with Cha 17, veto on deliberate harm except preventing greater harm, vocabulator for spoken Basic.

catalog.description: Disarming social infiltrator and covert negotiator
catalog.legacyNotes: Third-degree behavioral restrictions apply; armor proficiency is intentionally the level-1 general feat.

catalog.description: Agile security slicer, saboteur and digital thief
catalog.legacyNotes: Second-degree behavioral restrictions apply; abilities after size/degree are Dex 17 and Int 16.
